tests.exercises: A cold cosmic-ray current stream (eps = 0.1, u_CR = v_A/eps) drives Bell's non-resonant instability in a 1D periodic box. Particles push the gas through the MHD-PIC momentum/energy feedback source; the seeded perpendicular field grows exponentially and saturates before t = 10.
tests.why: official Test_Problems configuration; deterministic serial arithmetic, dbl output; pointwise under a round-off-level bound is the natural policy (flagged chaotic: nonlinear instability or turbulence amplifies round-off; the calibration spread decides the window)

tests.exercises: The same instability rotated in the x-y plane so the wavevector is oblique to the grid (Lx = sqrt5, Ly = sqrt5/2). tests.why: official Test_Problems configuration; deterministic serial arithmetic, dbl output; pointwise under a round-off-level bound is the natural policy (flagged chaotic: nonlinear instability or turbulence amplifies round-off; the calibration spread decides the window)
